issue.title: Previewed backfill: re-render pre-e9 generic Markdown ref PDFs so emoji and symbols print and extract

task_type_fields.proposal:
Add a previewed, opt-in backfill that re-renders existing generic Markdown reference PDFs
that were rendered before bob-cli-e9's fix (bob-cli 0e11f8b0, bob-cli-h8.11). Those PDFs
used DejaVu-only fonts with no fallback, so emoji and uncovered symbols (🍅 ✅ ⚠️ ▸ …)
print as missing glyphs, and the text layer carries U+FFFD/U+0000. The epic plan's
audit found U+FFFD in 193 of 498 `lib/chat/*.pdf` files with MuPDF.

Scope: a dry-run inventory that lists affected PDFs (for example by text-layer U+FFFD or
missing-glyph detection) and whether each has highlights or annotations. Re-render only
from the preserved write-once source Markdown
(decisions:reference-sources-are-preserved-write-once). Never clobber annotations:
skip or carry over annotated PDFs, and go only through the coordinated
`.forMerging` write path (decisions:open-pdf-writes-are-coordinated). Then report and
confirm before writing.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bob-cli-h8 epic plan forbade re-rendering existing PDFs inside ref-pdf-emoji, because Highlights PDFs carry annotations and need a coordinated, previewed write. bob-cli-h8.11 proposed it as a follow-up.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-h8.11 note #1 and required by the bob-cli-h8 plan's land-agent step: the e9 font fix only applies to new renders, so ~193 existing lib/chat PDFs still show missing glyphs.

payload.description: e9 fixed new generic Markdown renders; this backfills PDFs rendered before that fix
